text.aria-label: Title text 'How quickly each gate turns on, injected events of 7, 15, and 30 days (1,260 Primary-events) Higher and further left is faster. The curve stops below 1 when the gate never fires within the event.'
text.tspan: How quickly each gate turns on, injected events of 7, 15, and 30 days (1,260 Primary-events)
Higher and further left is faster. The curve stops below 1 when the gate never fires within the event.
